operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 Gas Terminal Division revenue was ₹2,410 Cr with a segment result of ₹496 Cr, against ₹1,463 Cr and ₹214 Cr a year earlier.
Other income of ₹87 Cr in Q4FY26 included ₹11,441 lakh profit on the slump sale of the Pipavav gas storage undertaking from ALL to Aegis Vopak Terminals.
Aegis Vopak Terminals' IPO of 119,148,936 shares at ₹235 diluted ALL's holding from 50.10% to 44.71%, with ALL retaining control.
FY26 LPG logistics volume was 5,152 '000 MT (+14% YoY) and distribution volume 754 '000 MT (+45% YoY), both the highest ever.
FY26 LPG sourcing volume was 607 '000 MT against 597 '000 MT in FY25 (+2%).
Liquid division revenue was ₹644 Cr in FY26 against ₹650 Cr in FY25, with EBITDA down 5% to ₹472 Cr.
LPG distribution volumes reached a record 2.77 lakh MT in Q1FY27, up 91% YoY and 19% QoQ.
LPG logistics throughput was 1.124 million MT, stable YoY; sourcing volumes 1.21 lakh MT, up 1% YoY.
Ammonia terminal at Pipavav commissioned with 36,000 MT static capacity and a 15-year take-or-pay agreement with Hindustan Zinc.
Tristar Holdings reported consolidated revenue of US$ 1,089 mn in 2023, US$ 1,220 mn in 2024, and US$ 1,401 mn in 2025.
Tristar Holdings generated c.US$ 1.4bn revenue, c.US$ 257mn EBITDA and c.US$ 82mn PAT in CY2025.
Commissioned a 35,000 MT per annum specialised LPG bottling plant at JNPA under the J2 Project, slated for subsequent transfer to AVTL.
Released October 2026 corporate presentation detailing Project GATI and infrastructure capacity.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,594.39 Cr (+52.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹410.37 Cr (+45.7% YoY).

Q4FY26 investor presentation (consolidated): FY26 revenue ₹8,333 Cr (+23% YoY), PAT ₹1,107 Cr (+41%); gas division EBITDA ₹1,131 Cr (+68%), liquid division EBITDA ₹472 Cr (-5%); Mumbai and JNPA liquid capacity commissioning expected in H1FY27.
Q1FY27 earnings call: PAT ₹545 Cr (+212% YoY), LPG EBITDA ₹591 Cr (+296%), ammonia terminal commissioned, $5 billion capex pipeline to FY31.
Board approved proposed acquisition of 89.8% stake in Dubai-based Tristar Holdings for US$ 809mn cash via Singapore subsidiary.
Aegis Logistics signed definitive agreements to acquire stake in Tristar Holdings for US$ 809 million.
Aegis Logistics commissioned a 35,000 MT/annum specialised LPG bottling plant at JNPA as part of the J2 Project.
On 16 October 2026, Aegis Logistics released its corporate presentation highlighting infrastructure scale and financial performance.
On October 16, 2026, Aegis Logistics informed the exchange that NSE Sustainability Ratings independently assigned an ESG score of 69.
2026-10-21: CARE Ratings placed Aegis Logistics' CARE AA long-term bank facilities on Rating Watch with Developing Implications and reaffirmed CARE A1+ short-term facilities.
Aegis Logistics secured shareholder approval at its EGM on October 21, 2026, for expanded borrowing limits, asset charges, and enabling fundraise securities.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,213.34 Cr (-3.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹260.59 Cr (+45.1% YoY).
